claims.statement: Editing declares FPT/GHEC/GHES; authors, organization write-or-higher and personal repository collaborators may edit. EMU conditional confines changes to enterprise repositories; exact operation authority remains target-dependent.

Title editing explicitly saves and records timeline change; description edit history can be removed by author/write user. UI edit history is therefore not immutable durable audit evidence or complete recovery receipt.

Type selection requires Save; CLI title/body and multi-issue add-label examples require exact issue/repository identities and compatible installed CLI. Multi-item examples do not guarantee atomicity/readback/rollback.
CLI parent/sub-issue add/remove separates edge edits from issue deletion. Dependency flags are FPT/GHEC conditional only; GHES adapter must not infer availability from generic issue-edit interface.
Slash command feature/version and public-preview qualifier must be resolved separately from support in a given issue/PR/discussion field; preview subject to change, not stable enforcement guarantee.

Code/details/table commands insert Markdown with chosen language/title/content/dimensions. Insertion is content editing, not code execution or accepted policy; upstream templates/code remain untrusted evidence.
Saved-replies inserts account-specific text and optional percent-cursor placeholder sets cursor location. Insertion is not submission, authorization or acknowledgment of source accuracy.

Template command lists repository templates and inserts selected issue or PR template. Template presence/insertion does not validate required values, create accepted controls or implement enforcement.
